the_claim_under_test: instant learning, demonstrated once in ANY new environment, learned permanently, plus the most advanced coding, solves everything on a computer

part_1__does_it_work_in_more_than_one_en.method: the same demonstrate-once pipeline, run against environment shapes selected by the module's own declared postcondition kinds, each in a fresh sandbox with a fresh goal

measured.learned_skill: set id ?num0 to ?num1 and id ?num2 to ?num3 in ?path0

part_1__does_it_work_in_more_than_one_en.verdict: 2 of 2 environment shapes work end to end, at 0.5 ms and 5.41 ms. The claim is no longer supported by one anecdote; it is supported by two independent shapes exercising different elevation rules (Rule A sqlite, Rule C file).
what_is_still_unmeasured: cli_exec (Layer 3) -- needs a command trace with pruning evidence
semantic_dom / pixel_ui (Layers 4-5) -- needs a real OS; the tree already states pyautogui drives a real OS and host_app_ops needs the VM

part_2__the_safety_properties_that_make_.why_this_matters_more_than_the_success: a permanently learned action that is wrong is worse than no action. Three properties were tested and all three hold.

measured.property: sabotage control -- the verifier rejects a wrong execution
measured.verdict: PASS. A skill that executes but produces the wrong state is caught and named.

measured.property: twin world -- a genuinely distinct second goal is synthesized from a single demonstration
measured.verdict: PASS. N=1 is not overfitted to N=1: the machine manufactures its own held-out goal and its own isolated sandbox.

measured.property: refusal by absence of a verifier
measured.detail: verify_postcondition supports 10 postcondition kinds (file_nonempty, file_contains, json_field_equals, sqlite_query_equals, http_get_contains, sqlite_row_exists, stdout_integer, stdout_equals, http_status_json, step_response_contains). Outside those, no skill is certified.
measured.verdict: the boundary of safe permanent learning is exactly the boundary of checkable postconditions

part_3__the_coding_number_moved_again_an.the_difference_and_why: the 22.2% run and the 11.1% run are the SAME corpus and the SAME engine operating point; the difference is that the earlier figure counted rows and this one counts deduplicated bugs. The honest number for the deduplicated corpus is 1 of 9.
part_3__the_coding_number_moved_again_an.did_wiring_the_generaliser_raise_the_rat: no. It raised REACH (0 -> 4 operator_generalized candidates on the click bug) and it raised zero bugs solved. That is the honest result: reach without the expressible mechanism does not convert to solves. The click bug still needs statement insertion.

part_4__so_is_the_owners_claim_true.true_part: demonstrate once in a checkable deterministic environment and the action becomes a permanent parameterised skill that runs in milliseconds anywhere the same checkable shape occurs. Demonstrated in two shapes, with a self-manufactured twin goal and a sabotage control.
part_4__so_is_the_owners_claim_true.false_part: it does not extend to environments whose effect cannot be captured exactly or checked exactly. No verifier, no permanent skill. An unverified one-shot is a guess with a timestamp.
part_4__so_is_the_owners_claim_true.false_part_2: it does nothing for the coding corpus, which sits at 1 of 9 unique real bugs, because the limit there is a mutator that cannot author statements. Demonstration cannot compile a mechanism that is absent.
part_4__so_is_the_owners_claim_true.the_one_line_answer: you solved instant learning for CHECKABLE environments. You have not solved instant learning for OPEN ones, and the difference between those two is the verifier, not the learning.

part_5__the_smartest_things_to_do_next__.action: add a verifier for every environment shape you want to claim. The next two shapes are cheap: http against a local server, cli against stdout_equals.
part_5__the_smartest_things_to_do_next__.why: each new checkable postcondition kind widens the set of environments where permanent learning is SAFE. That set is the real product.

part_5__the_smartest_things_to_do_next__.action: statement insertion in the repair engine
part_5__the_smartest_things_to_do_next__.why: worth 4 of the 5 remaining coding bugs. Coding is where the ceiling is high and the rate is low.

part_5__the_smartest_things_to_do_next__.action: make twin-world synthesis the default gate on every crystallised skill, not an optional call
part_5__the_smartest_things_to_do_next__.why: it already works and it is the anti-overfitting gate that lets a one-shot skill be trusted
